rtu_frame_waveform.frame_layout: Address (1 B) | Function Code (1 B) | Data (0..252 B) | CRC-Lo (1 B) | CRC-Hi (1 B) — total ≤ 256 B.
rtu_frame_waveform.start_of_frame: First bit of the first byte after ≥ T3.5 silent line.
rtu_frame_waveform.byte_transmission: 1 start + 8 data LSB-first + parity (even default) + 1 stop bit (or 2 stop bits if no parity).
rtu_frame_waveform.inter_character_gap_intra_frame: Up to T1.5 character times allowed between bytes of the same frame.
rtu_frame_waveform.end_of_frame_silence: ≥ T3.5 character times of silent line.
rtu_frame_waveform.wire_polarity: Idle line = mark (HIGH); start bit = space (LOW).

tcp_frame_waveform.mbap_header: Transaction ID (2 B) | Protocol ID (2 B = 0x0000) | Length (2 B) | Unit ID (1 B) — 7 B.
tcp_frame_waveform.no_extra_crc: MODBUS TCP has no per-PDU CRC; integrity via Ethernet CRC-32 + TCP checksum.
tcp_frame_waveform.concurrent_transactions: Client may have multiple outstanding requests via Transaction ID.

request_response_timing.client_request_timeout: Implementation-defined; typical 100..500 ms for RTU at 9600 baud, 1..5 s for TCP.
request_response_timing.broadcast_no_response: Broadcast frames elicit no response; client waits T_broadcast_interval.
request_response_timing.comm_error_no_response: Parity/framing/CRC/LRC error → no response; client times out.

crc_lrc_computation_timing.rtu_crc_throughput: 1 byte / 8 cycles bit-serial, or 1 byte / 1 cycle table-based.

absolute_max_ratings.n_a_at_protocol_layer: MODBUS is OSI level 7; absolute maxima belong to the chosen physical layer.
